rows.en: Murk: "Damn it! What on earth is going on?!
Staff Member: "Repairs are underway! We estimate it'll take at least
one ris, about forty minutes, to restore it!"
Honestly, every last one of you...
Hey! Ah... What happened to that one? Um..."
Murk: "...What are you doing inside the equipment locker?"
Assistant: "Heh heh heh... Just taking a little nap..."
Staff Member: "No, I don't think you're supposed to accept that..."
Murk: "...Hm? What's that peculiar machine on your back?"
Assistant: "What do you mean? You developed it, Doctor.
It's the 'Universal Integrated Communications and Observation Device,' isn't it?"
But if I made it, its performance is assured.
Hmm. Looking closely, it's quite stylish, too.
Staff Member: "No, really, this isn't the time
Hey, are you the cause of this mess?
You are, aren't you?! No, it must be you!"
Murk: "Hmm. If it wasn't you, who on earth was it?
Who would do this much damage
Staff Member: "I-It couldn't possibly have been me!"
What happened to the emergency power?!"
Murk: "I can see that without being told!
Why didn't the emergency power start up immediately?
Murk: "Again...? How many times has it been terrible today?"
Staff Member: "It seems the field was breached in the brief interval
0049 and others, eighteen in all, have escaped the grounds!"
Assistant: "0033... Isn't that the one you modified
Staff Member: "I told you so many times not to add a self-replication function...
I told you it was a bad idea..."
They'll cut our budget again at this rate..."
Staff Member: "I don't think that's the problem..."
The field has been restored, hasn't it?"
Assistant: "Yes. It looks like the security problems have been fixed, too."
Murk: "Perhaps I skimped a bit too much on security...
No... It's too convenient... The timing is too good...
Run a virus check, just in case.
Though I doubt you'll find anything..."
Assistant: "Some of the escaped test subjects
Staff Member: "West would be... York, wouldn't it?
If I remember correctly, Zigrim is invading there now...
Murk: "...I don't know. I haven't heard a thing.
Staff Member: "There you go acting like a child again..."
Isn't this a chance to see how the test subjects behave in the wild
Heh heh heh... More valuable data for me..."
Murk: "All right! Now that it's decided, we must act at once!
D-Do I have to go, too?"
Murk: "Stop complaining and come along! Let's go!"
Celica: "Yes, yes. If you've got time to talk, move your hands!"
Mechanic B: "Ether Engines two and four adjusted!"
Mechanic C: "Electronic drive system settings complete!"
Mechanic A: "Bridge! How's the central control unit?!"
Mechanic F: "G-Give me another fifteen deo, six minutes!"
Mechanic A: "Finish it in five deo, two minutes!"
Mechanic A: "That makes two of us.
All right! At this point, we'll finish it no matter what!"
Celica: (Sorry, everyone. But if we don't hurry...)
Touya: "But I can't see it anywhere."
Arthur: "I thought there'd be a facility, but...
I certainly didn't expect a battleship in a place like this."
Ai: "Huh? Where? All I see is a waterfall."
